correctness.rationale: The origin row and its subtraction produce rank(M)=1+rank(T). Multiplicative-character decomposition of functions on nonzero field coordinates block-diagonalizes T up to permutation of character channels. Each nontrivial channel is a nonzero Gauss-sum scalar times a weighted cycle adjacency C_chi; the trivial channel is -q C_1. For odd d the two Hamiltonian cycle terms give determinant 2 product_i chi(w_i)^(-1), nonzero over complex numbers even when char(F_q)=2. For d=2m the parity-ordered cyclic bidiagonal block has exactly two perfect matching terms; singularity is chi(r)=(-1)^m, with rank exactly m-1 by its nonzero triangular (m-1)-minor. Evaluation at r of multiplicative order h assumes each h-th root exactly (q-1)/h times, giving the claimed complex nullity. Independent direct construction of 25 matrices for p in {2,3,5}, d=3..7 and nonzero edge assignments confirmed the formula; this finite check is not the all-q proof. Ambient B need not be invertible; theorem is about the restricted M, not full Fourier inversion.
residual_risks: Full characteristic-two extension-field families and all cycle lengths are proved by the character argument, not independently enumerated; no assertion of numerical conditioning.
